episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Cha Hyun Soo moves into the run-down Green Home by himself. Not long after, he witnesses a disturbing sight in his neighbor's apartment.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As a state of emergency is declared, the residents tie up Pyun Sang Wook for being bitten. Hyun-su is unable to ignore a family in distress.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: An unexpected savior protects the children from harm as Hyun-su, together with Yoon Ji Soo and Jung Jae Hun, tries to bring them to safety.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Critical information about the monsters is made public. When residents are split on what to do with Hyun Soo, Lee Eun Hyuk suggests they hold a vote.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Tasked to carry out dangerous missions, Hyun Soo heads back to retrieve Han Du Shik. Sang Wook stops at nothing to finish what he started.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: An Sun Young confronts the greatest monster in her life. Leaving the building, Seo Yi Kyung heads to her fiancé's office in search of answers.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Hyun Soo saves the others from a deadly attack. Running out of necessities, Eun Hyuk announces a plan to venture outside for resources.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Having little options in her state of being, Ji Soo agrees to take a big risk. Yi Kyung returns to Green Home just in time.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: When a team of outlaws take over the building, the residents are shown how humans can be even more barbaric than the monsters.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: A military leaflet promises a route to safety, but the group is reluctant to trust it. Hyun Soo is exposed to a new perspective on his condition.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Hyun-su wakes up to find Sang-wook, who has a new goal for them. Lee Eun-yu and Ji-su escape a violent evacuation and commandeer their next destination.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Eun-yu finds a hint of Eun-hyeok's fate at a stop in her journey. During an experiment, Hyun-su finds that he has a special effect on another monster.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: On a mission to find her husband, Yi-kyung makes a shocking discovery. The battered Ji-su and Eun-yu arrive at a new shelter, but catastrophe awaits them.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The survivors take shelter underground, where supplies run low. In her continued search for Eun-hyeok, Eun-yu encounters a young girl.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Sergeant Kim and Master Sergeant Tak clash on how to protect their men. The mysterious girl approaches Eun-yu with an enticing offer.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Eun-yu chases Yi-kyung and the girl, with Park Chan-yeong right behind her. The death of survivors and a missing soldier throws the stadium into unrest.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Eun-yu shares a terse reunion with Hyun-su. While the platoon embarks on their search for a missing soldier, the stadium experiences a monster threat.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: As Yi-kyung faces death, the young girl tries to save her. In the ruins of the lab, the soldiers discover other survivors who aren't what they seem.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Sergeant Kim goes up against countless monsters to make it out alive with his men. Seeing the humanity in Yi-kyung, Hyun-su tries to bring her back.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Resolved to find his child, Jung Ui-myeong heads to the stadium. Despite Hyun-su's unpredictability, Eun-yu tries to wake him up during a sudden crisis.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Yi-kyung discovers Ui-myeong's true motive for him and their daughter. Eun-yu accepts a challenge from Hyun-su's alter ego and heads to the stadium.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The girl contemplates her future with Yi-kyung — and a life away from Ui-myeong. Sergeant Kim encounters Eun-hyeok, who reveals a new kind of being.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Eun-hyeok's reunion with Hyun-su and Eun-yu turns into chaos. Ui-myeong prepares for his body transfer, while Sergeant Tak carries out his own plan.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: In her trek to the stadium, Eun-yu begins to feel a personal worry. While Ui-myeong searches for the girl, she plans a counterattack in the background.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Hyun-su and Eun-hyeok arrive at the stadium, splitting up to find Ui-myeong. During the great escape, Sergeant Tak commits the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: In their battle to stop Ui-myeong, Hyun-su and Eun-hyeok confront the girl head-on — getting an assist from an old friend. Will they finally succeed?
